chunks: From him, from al-Ḥasan, from Faḍālah, from Ḥammād ibn ʿUthmān, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
I said: I reach the morning having missed the witr until the night; how should I make it up? He said: Like for like.

key_terms.أَقْضِي: I make up; I perform as qada'
key_terms.أُصْبِحُ: I enter the morning; I reach daybreak
key_terms.الْوَتْرِ: the witr prayer, the odd-numbered night prayer in this context
key_terms.مِثْلًا بِمِثْلٍ: like for like; in a corresponding manner

ai.seo_question: How should the missed witr prayer be made up if it is delayed until the night?
ai.summary: This hadith addresses the ruling of making up the witr prayer when it has been missed until morning and delayed until night. The Imam عليه السلام replies that it is to be made up correspondingly, indicating that it should be performed in the same manner as originally prescribed.
